guidelines: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2024 / RSSDI Guidelines
lifestyleActions: Incorporate 150 minutes per week of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise plus 2-3 resistance training sessions.
Front-load fiber and protein at dinner; avoid late-night refined carbohydrates to curb the dawn phenomenon.
Check HbA1c to assess 3-month glycemic control.
redFlags: Fasting blood sugar > 250 mg/dL accompanied by nausea, vomiting, confusion, or fruity breath requires immediate urgent evaluation to rule out Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).

protocol: Administer 15-20 grams of rapid-acting simple carbohydrate (e.g., 4 ounces / 120 mL of fruit juice, 3-4 glucose tablets, or 1 tablespoon of sugar/honey).
Wait 15 minutes in a seated or resting position, then retest blood glucose.
If blood sugar remains < 70 mg/dL, repeat the 15g intake.
Once normalized (>= 70 mg/dL), consume a small balanced snack (complex carbs + protein) if the next meal is more than an hour away.
redFlags: Loss of consciousness, seizures, or inability to swallow safely requires immediate emergency injection of glucagon and dialing 112.
